title: Citi: Our Corporate Banker, Bertram, Tells You About His Career
description: Interested in a Career at Citi? Bertram, Explains About Working in Corporate Banking.  Citi Careers University Program: http://www.oncampus.citi.com Citi Careers Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/citicareers Citi Careers Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CitiCareers/  View other Citi videos: http://www.youtube.com/citi Read our Blog: http://blog.citigroup.com Like us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/citi Follow us on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/citi Follow us on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/citi Follow us on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/citi Follow us on Google+: http://www.google.com/+citi

asr.full_text: We represent Citi services to our current clients and potential clients. Relationship management is key to our division. I liaise with people from other departments as well as people in other countries. We're in constant dialogue with other divisions like Treasury and Trade Solutions and markets. When we're not meeting with people, we're making slides for presentations, reviewing Citi's current book of clients, or working on predictive modeling and industry research. The Citi Corporate Banking division also benefits from Citi's global network. I'm based in London, but we provide industry support to tons of other countries too. So I get exposure to lots of different regions and their ways of working. Ever since I heard from some of Citi's senior leaders during insight week, I've always wanted to join. We're doing some really interesting work. Especially as digital disruption changes the operating landscape for our clients. Corporate banking at Citi has shown me what a global network feels like and I can't wait to see more.
